what_happened: Re-deriving the nine CI checks from the live .github/workflows/ci.yml (as the dispatch instructed) surfaced that the dispatch's own drafted check list omitted required arguments on 3 of 9 checks (check-copyright-headers.sh and readme-lint.sh both need 'FormalSystem BimodalTools', not bare; lake exe mk_all needs '--lib FormalSystem --check', not bare '--check') and that check 9 (lint-style) is actually three sub-checks bundled into one CI step outcome. Caught before planning/implementation rather than after.

Plan phase: suite_selection_select over this task's three touched paths (scripts/verify-all.sh, CONTRIBUTING.md, scripts/README.md) returned a MIXED output -- __FULL_SWEEP__ for the first two, plus 17 core agent-system suites mapped from scripts/README.md alone. The mapping appears to be a generic scripts/README.md path match in the agent-system's own suite map rather than real coverage of this Lean repo's file, so Tier Justification lines name verify-touched.sh as the command without asserting a suite list, per plan-format.md's mixed-output honesty rule. No research re-round was needed: the research report's re-derivation of ci.yml's nine invocations was byte-exact against lines 127-267 of the live file at plan-authoring time.

scripts/verify-all.sh ran end-to-end on the current tree and correctly surfaced a genuine pre-existing check-paper-definitions.sh content drift (8 PASS, 1 FAIL, 0 SKIPPED) while all later checks still executed, confirming the continue-past-failure design works without needing an artificial seed for this particular property.

A full scripts/verify-all.sh run (nine checks, including check-evidence-probes.sh and check-module-invariants.sh --no-build) exceeded 10 minutes wall time; required a bounded detached run (timeout 1500 + kill -0 liveness loop) rather than a single foreground Bash call to observe completion.
